comments: 65a9efe6: ;Call the DE routine to initialize file variables and get data.
967e8781: ;Set up file variables and check for existing data.
72572993: ;If DATE/TIME LAST UPDATED field exists, save the time portion in DE(1).
bb78ac4f: ;Kill utility variable and quit.
1ae4bbfd: Print the prompt for the user input
b636e8f8: Return to the caller without accepting any input
7d1f0f52: If the length of the input field exceeds the available space on the current line, wrap to the next line
344c7006: If the input field is longer than 19 characters, and no DᲘᲕC or DᲘᲕL parameters are set, and DᲘᲕC contains 'F' or 'K', go to the RW^DIR2 label
3df4f3c8: If the DᲘᲕC parameter is set to 'I' and the DE(DQ) array is defined, display '(No Editing)' and set the user input X to an empty string
860157a1: Read user input into X with a timeout, set DTOUT and X to U (up-arrow) if timed out, and issue a beep
c9b7d826: Return to the caller
62eec2f5: Increment the DQ counter.
4076daa9: Execution continues at the location indicated by the DQ counter.
f9af195d: Loop to PR if the DE array indicates that there are more entries to process, otherwise perform W and TR.
6f577af1: If X is empty, go to A unless DV contains 'R', in which case go to X; if DV does not contain 'R', go to X if the incremental D value is not positive, otherwise go to A.
599633f7: If X starts with '?', go to QS; if X starts with '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
57ae3985: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.

e7af4534: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the ^DISV array for the current user contains an entry for DLB, set X to the value from ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB); if DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write ' ' followed by X.
dcea6b6d: If description for that field value exists, display it
a517cd35: Loop through the description multiple to find a match for the value, quit if found
1f44fade: If no match found, display remainder of description multiple, and set internal value
7a19260e: If DIC(0) is 'L' then DLAYGO is set to the 2nd piece of DV after the 'P'. If DV does not contain '*' then we call ^DIC and set X to the newly created entry number. If X is negative we quit.
5b258b7e: If DV does not contain 'N' then go to V. If the length of X after the decimal point is greater than 24 characters then X is killed and we go to Z.

1ce34a5f: If the 2nd piece of DV (after the ',') is non-zero and X contains a decimal point and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) does not contain '$' then: If the portion of X before the decimal is '00' then X is set to null string. If the first character of X is '0' then X is stripped of the leading '0'. If the first character of X after the decimal is '0' then the trailing '0' is removed. If X has no portion after the decimal and contains '.' then X is converted to numeric.
ac2f712a: The code pointed to by the X_DQ is executed. YS is killed.
3f775737: DIC("S") and DLAYGO are killed. If X is defined and not equal to the at-sign (U) then DG(DW) is set to X. If DV contains 'd' then ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) is set to X and execution goes to A.
325fed56: ;Quit if database is defined
105054d9: ;Set X to Bad if there is an error
2bcb416c: ;Execute D, QQ^DIEQ, and go to B
58b6a2ae: ;Set D to field number, DQ(DQ) to data attributes and executable code
e2a923aa: ;If input transform is not defined, do output transform. If X is not null and not Read, go to A. If X is null, go to X.
49c7afa8: ;Set DG to variable pointer, Y to input transform, and X to input value. If there is a Input Transformation, execute it and go to RP.
2966c7cf: ;Evaluate pointer-type data
d1393ff8: ;Evaluate variable pointer data
4f7f6d1e: ;Execute FileMan UTILITY code
7dc5fd1e: ;Get the next 'X' node from the 'DE' X-ref and quit if not found, or if the X-ref is corrupt, or if the X-ref has been killed.
ad279c0b: If the data value (DV) does not contain 'I' or '#', go to the 'RD' label.
9bbce991: Execute the ^DIE0 routine and go to the 'RD' label if 'X' is defined, otherwise go to the 'PR' label.
ac98aaa4: Quit the routine.
ad975c73: Set the variable names for the routine: DNM='DGJXE10', DQ=1 (initialize loop counter).

a86200c5: Set variables for the current field being processed: DW='DT;2' (file global location), DV='P200' (data validation), DU='' (initial default value), DLB='DICTATED BY' (field label), DIFLD=10.02 (field number).
5b1a1bc3: Append the starting global location for file #200 to the DU variable.
b0ce9247: Go to the 'RE' label.
6af73861: Exit the 'X1' label/routine.

0ddf3b8d: If the DG array is larger than 9 entries, execute the F^DIE17 routine and then the DE^DIE17 routine. Set Y=U (undefined), DQ=2 (update loop counter). Call the X2 routine. If Y is undefined or equal to U, go to the 'A' label. Otherwise, set X=Y, DIC(0)='F' (file editing mode), DW=DQ (update global location), and go to the OUT^DIE17 label.
7e7794bc: If X is null/empty, set multiple fields in the ^VAS(393,D0,'DT') global node to null. Set DGJTST='INCOMPLETE' and Y='@2' (input transform).
b13aaf43: Exit/quit the current routine.
f67613a4: ;If the Data is found (DG D-array exists) and the User input = '^', pass the control to the output routine.
38feaf10: ;Sets the DGJTST variable to the string 'DICTATED'.
6cfb9836: ;Quit the current execution.
56024180: ;If the Data is found (DG D-array exists) and the User input = '^', pass the control to the DGJXE11 routine.
